summary: Master the art of marketing strategy and planning with our expert-led training course. Equip yourself with essential skills to drive business growth.
lede: Marketing strategy and planning helps marketing professionals turn market and customer evidence into focused priorities and measurable activity. For professionals involved in marketing decisions, the course develops skills in market diagnosis and audience segmentation, value proposition and channel planning, and setting budgets, KPIs, and reporting routines that connect execution with commercial objectives.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already contribute to marketing decisions and now need greater control over strategic analysis, planning quality, resource allocation, and performance reporting. It suits professionals who can work with established marketing data and want to strengthen the connection between customer insight and commercial execution.
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to marketing activity, campaign reporting, customer insight, brand management, product marketing, or commercial planning. The course uses spreadsheets, structured templates, and dashboard concepts rather than programming. Advanced topics such as marketing mix modelling and AI-assisted analysis receive operational overview coverage, while segmentation, positioning, channel planning, budgeting, and KPI design receive hands-on application.
